audit.whatIsWrong: Five of seven rows contradicted their own why-text. The chart read Jax at level 1 while whys[0] says 'you can't catch him at level 1'; Singed at 3 and 4-5 while whys[2] calls it 'your first real window' and whys[3] says you out-damage him; Jax at 6 while whys[4] calls it a coinflip; Singed at first item while whys[5] says the spike rarely lands.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Singed/Skill/Jax/Jax/Skill/Skill/Singed at 48.56% over 696 games. The mirror (singed__jax) already realigned its whole chart to the packet as one atomic group, so this side must be the inverse of that.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Singed / Skill / Jax / Jax / Skill / Skill / Singed in both layers, ratings realigned to 3, 5, 7, 7, 5, 5, 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike described your ultimate's resists as a passive state and never mentioned that Insanity Potion applies Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Your ultimate's Armor/MR is an activation on a 110/100/90s cooldown, not a standing steroid — the mirror already corrected that on its side. Insanity Potion is a flat 100s and makes Poison Trail apply healing reduction, which directly cuts the Conqueror and Sundered Sky healing your all-in is built on. That is the real reason level 6 is a coinflip rather than a kill.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now names the 100s Insanity Potion and its Grievous Wounds; phases[4].why says the same.
sources: brief enemyKit R cd 100, flags antiHeal

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader to hold Counter Strike for his damage. Counter Strike dodges basic attacks; Poison Trail is not an attack, so the dodge does nothing against Singed's actual damage source. Mega Adhesive's grounding — which shuts off Leap Strike — was never stated as the decisive interaction.
audit.why: Riot's Counter Strike text: dodges all incoming attacks. Poison Trail is a toggled ground effect at 13 mana with no cooldown, so E's only value in this lane is the recast stun on a Fling. Mega Adhesive (17/16/15/14/13s, 1000 range) grounds — Leap Strike cannot be used out of it, and a Fling that lands you in the goo roots instead of just knocking up. The mirror audit reached the same two conclusions independently.
audit.corrected: report[5].t re-states Counter Strike as attack-dodge only; breakdown.cooldowns carries Fling's 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, the Mega Adhesive root condition and its grounding; phases[6].why names the grounding as why late Singed is uncatchable.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was tracked without a number, and Mega Adhesive — the longer, more punishing cooldown — was not tracked at all.
audit.why: Fling is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s; Mega Adhesive is 17s at rank 1 and is the ability that denies your escape and your chase.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d rewritten with both numbers.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Singed contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Poison Trail costs him 13 mana and no cooldown, and Counter Strike dodges attacks — he never autos, so you cannot punish.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Singed's Fling is down.
edits.after: Empower punishes a step-up, but his poison sustain heals the chip and his speed denies follow-up — even.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Singed must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full combo online: recast Counter Strike to stun his Fling (10s at rank 1) and burst him before he greases away.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Fling's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Ranking Counter Strike keeps the recast stun up for every Fling commit, and Q-Empower out-damages a man who never autos back.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Singed's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your ultimate's resists let you eat Poison Trail, but Insanity Potion lands the same second and its Grievous Wounds cuts your healing.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Fling's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force out-trades him standing still, but he proxies and kites, so the spike rarely lands.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Singed carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A Rylai's/Liandry's drain tank melts you through your resists and Mega Adhesive grounds Leap Strike — end before this.

edits.before: His flip. E the follow-up. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Fling is 10s at rank 1 — recast Counter Strike to stun the commit.

edits.before: - Singed Fling: matchup-defining — His flip. E the follow-up. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Singed Fling: 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s — flips you, and roots instead if you land in Mega Adhesive (17s at rank 1, and it grounds Leap Strike). - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Track Singed's Fling: His flip. E the follow-up. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges attacks, not Poison Trail — only the recast stun matters.

edits.before: Grandmaster at Arms' Armor/MR active lets you eat his Poison Trail in an all-in, but Insanity Potion makes him faster, tankier and harder to slow at the same moment — the trade is a coinflip, not a free kill.
edits.after: Your R's Armor/MR active lets you eat Poison Trail in an all-in, but Insanity Potion (flat 100s) lands the same moment: faster, tankier, and his poison now applies Grievous Wounds to cut the healing you fight on.
